resolved.title: 商品打折
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定一个数组，其中包含了全部商品的价格。

编写一个程序，输入打折百分比，在一行中以相同的顺序输出折扣后的商品价格，中间用空格（" "）隔开。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Arrays[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given an array of doubles of items in a store that have different prices (see template).
Write a program that takes the "percent off" discount as input and outputs discounted item prices on one line in the same sequence you are given, separated by a space (" ").

[b]Sample Input[/b]
25

[b]Sample Output[/b]
375 9.3 70.5 33.75 2.25 60.75 750.675 63.75 67.5 0.75 26.25

[note]To get a discounted price use the formula: a – a*p/100, where a is the initial price and p is the discount percent off.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 要得到折扣后的价格，请使用公式：`a-a*p/100`，其中a是初始价格，p是折扣百分比。
